card.name: Fixed-dose combination product wording
card.fires_on: The final piece of 'dose' in 'fixed-dose' (or the word 'dose' after 'fixed') when a label describes a multi-drug combination tablet. It is strongest right before 'combination product containing'.

modes.label: Fixed-dose combination
modes.description: The 'dose' in 'fixed-dose' in dosage sections describing a two-, three- or four-drug product.
modes.example: 2.4 Recommended Dosage in Adults TRIUMEQ is a fixed-d<<ose>> combination product containing 600 mg

modes.label: Other product-name pieces
modes.description: Occasional parts of drug or brand names in the same label setting.
